tasks.subject: Refactor useAgent to update messages incrementally
tasks.description: In src/tui/hooks/useAgent.ts: on send(), immediately append user message + an empty assistant placeholder message to `messages` state (optimistic). Track the in-progress assistant message id via a ref (for callbacks) + state (for rendering). Wire onText/onToolCall/onToolResult to mutate that message by id. On onTurnStart(turn>1) create a new placeholder. Use finally to reset isThinking/streaming id. Drop the separate streamedText state. Expose streamingMessageId. Pass pre-user `messages` as history to runAgentLoop (loop keeps its own internal copy for API context).

tasks.subject: Update app.tsx to use streamingMessageId
tasks.description: In src/tui/app.tsx: drop streamedText, drop the streamingMessage = messages[last] computation. Read streamingMessageId from useAgent and pass it down to ChatPanel instead of streamingMessage + streamedText.

tasks.subject: Switch ChatPanel to streamingMessageId prop
tasks.description: In src/tui/components/ChatPanel.tsx: replace streamingMessage (Message|undefined) + streamedText (string) props with a single streamingMessageId (string|null) prop. Set isStreaming={msg.id === streamingMessageId} on AgentMessage. Remove streamedText passthrough.

tasks.subject: Drop streamedText from AgentMessage, use message.content
tasks.description: In src/tui/components/AgentMessage.tsx: remove the streamedText prop. displayContent is always message.content (now updated live by the hook while streaming). Keep isStreaming for the Thinking spinner + streaming spinner logic.

tasks.subject: Typecheck after refactor
tasks.description: Run npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) to ensure the refactor compiles cleanly with no dangling references to removed props/state.
